name: dispense_controlled_substance
description: Process a controlled substance dispense from central pharmacy to a clinic, enforcing DEA validity, schedule-class witness requirements, and creating the controlled substance log. Policy: pol_dea_registration_required, pol_dea_registration_expired, pol_schedule_ii_witness_required, pol_controlled_dispense_log, pol_staff_suspended_blocked

dispense_request_id.description: ID of the dispense_request record (must have status=pending)
dispense_request_id.title: Dispense Request Id

name: log_controlled_dispense
description: Create an immutable controlled_substance_log entry for a completed dispense event. Requires dispense_request.status=dispensed. For Schedule II drugs witness_staff_id must be present. Policy: pol_controlled_dispense_log, pol_schedule_ii_witness_required

dispense_request_id.description: ID of the already-dispensed dispense_request record
dispense_request_id.title: Dispense Request Id

name: verify_dea_registration
description: Verify that a veterinarian holds a valid (active, non-expired) DEA registration credential before allowing a controlled substance dispense. Returns {valid: bool, failure_code: str|null}. Writes audit_log on failure. Policy: pol_dea_registration_required, pol_dea_registration_expired

vet_id.description: Staff member ID of the requesting veterinarian
vet_id.title: Vet Id
